title: Avatar Medical and Kyber collect €3.7 million to carry 3D medical picture wey dey show body like real tin reach more hospital
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf

html:
Avatar Medical and Kyber don announce today say dem don collect reach €3.7 million from di France 2030 program wey French goment dey run, to build Avatar MediVerse, one project wey go make 3D medical picture of each patient body, wey dey carry pesin enta inside, dey available anywhere wey doctors and patients need am.

As tins be now, to show patient or doctor how body be for real 3D wey no need special glasses, you go need plenty computer power wey must siddon near di screen, and dis one fit mean say na only some special rooms wey get di equipment fit do am. MediVerse dey designed to carry dat computer power go anoda place far away, come stream di 3D experience as e dey happen for real time. Surgeon fit show patient di tumor wey e wan comot during consultation, check di same body picture of dat patient wen e dey plan di operation, come carry di same view enter operating room.

Avatar MediVerse join two French technology wey dey complete each oda. Avatar Medical dey bring Avatar Medical Vision, im software wey FDA don clear and wey get CE mark, wey dey turn ordinary CT and MRI scan to 3D picture wey resemble real body and wey pesin fit play with, without say anybody go need cut di picture into parts by hand. Di company still get experience of working with pass 20 hospitals for U.S. and Europe. Kyber dey provide di real-time system wey latency no too dey, wey dey render di experience from far and stream am.

E no be like to stream ordinary flat video. To show real depth, you must send separate picture enter each eye for real time, and e must fast well-well so dat di body picture go respond sharp-sharp anytime doctor move am or turn am round to see am better.

“To dey work with medical picture as e dey happen for real time na one of di hardest latency wahala wey dey anywhere.” Na so Jean-Baptiste Kempf, CEO of Kyber, tok. “Small delay wey nobody go even notice for video call go scatter di picture finish wen each eye dey receive im own view. Na to solve dis one go open door for every oda tin. As we join di 3D picture wey Avatar Medical dey make wey dey carry pesin enta inside, with di real-time streaming system wey Kyber get, MediVerse go make all dat kain work smooth, no mata di place or di device wey pesin dey use. E be strong example of how French deep-tech innovation fit solve real health wahala wey get meaning for pipo life.”

For Avatar Medical, MediVerse na one important step for im bigger vision wey dem call Visual Intelligence for Surgery, wey be to make picture information of each patient dey available from start to finish for di whole surgery journey, instead make di correct 3D picture just tie to one computer or one room. As MediVerse dey separate di computer power from di place wey pipo dey look di picture, e fit make 3D picture wey pesin fit play with easy to spread across hospitals, health systems and different places wey dey give care for different parts of di world.

“We choose to build dis tin with di best real-time technology wey dey, and e just happen say na French technology,” na so Elodie Litzler, deputy CEO and co-founder of Avatar Medical, tok. “No be one of us fit do dis one alone. Wetin we dey find no be just new equipment for hospital, but to change how patients and doctors take understand wetin dem dey look, and di place wey dat understanding fit happen.”

Since dem build di project on top open-source technology, e still wan give hospitals more control over dia own system and reduce how dem dey depend on private platforms wey dey show picture from far.

Dem give di award through di France 2030 call for projects wey dem call “Innovative Technology for Virtual World Wey Dey Carry Pesin Enta Inside”, after one independent committee of experts don check di project well, and Bpifrance go dey oversee how dem go take do di work on behalf of French goment.

About Kyber

Kyber na French deep-tech company wey dey build real-time system for health, robotics, cloud rendering and video apps wey artificial intelligence dey power. Make you learn more for https://kyber.tech .

About Avatar Medical

Dem start Avatar Medical for 2020, and na im dey lead di road for Visual Intelligence for Surgery, as e dey build solution wey fit grow big, wey dey turn medical picture to visual information wey doctors fit act on, from start to finish for di whole surgery journey. Im main product, Avatar Medical Vision, dey turn CT and MRI scan to 3D picture wey resemble real body and wey pesin fit play with, sharp-sharp and without cutting di picture into parts, so dat doctors go get easier way to understand di body of each patient, plan operation, work togeda and tok with patients. From consultation and di planning before operation reach inside operating room, di company dey work to make visual intelligence dey available anywhere wey dem dey take serious surgery decision. Avatar Medical come out from research wey dem do for Institut Curie and Institut Pasteur, and im technology products don get FDA clearance and CE mark. Di company dey work with pass 20 hospitals for U.S. and Europe. Make you learn more for avatarmedical.ai .
